The '''Amban JP blaster rifle''' was a model of two-pronged [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]<ref name="Cartel Market" /> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> It was very similar in appearance to the [[Amban phase-pulse blaster/Legends|Amban phase-pulse blaster]] used millennia later.<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Story of the Faithful Wookiee]]''</ref>

The [[Mandalorian shock trooper]] [[Troya Ajak]] used an Amban JP blaster rifle during the [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack on the ''Spirit of Vengeance II'']].<ref name="TOR:SoV">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>
